title: Best way to make a 2d Pokemon style game with AI
author: Live-Till-3545
selftext: Don't have a large budget. What models, tools, asset gen tools, etc do I need?

replies.body: I mean... They didn't say "A Pokemon fan-game" but "A Pokemon style game." comments.author: ItsAlwaysTerminal
comments.body: I mean to actually make one you need to develop a workflow. The coding aspect is not difficult anymore and honestly I bet I could do it in a ChatGPT Plus plan with just minimal prompting, though I run a Max 20x plan because of much heavier work. Your problem will be asset generation. Pokemon uses 2D sprites which are both easy and notoriously painful because current models dont output clean pixel formats and also dont always follow prompt guidelines for things like sprite sheets. The best option is a LoRA built for sprites on your own workflow. You will need a midrange GPU to do that locally and understanding how to wire up something like ComfyUI. I'd recommend looking at how to connect a coding agent like Claude Code/Desktop or Codex to an MCP and then how to structure your prompts so you are blowing massive amounts of prompting on useless shit. I start with a PRD/spec and then break things into systems and create plans for each system that only then are provided to the coding agents.
